  4. DISCUSSION ITEMS

  A. BRIEF REVIEW OF THE BROWN ACT AS IT PERTAINS TO COMMITTEES

  Staff will provide an overview of the Brown Act, which guarantees the public’s right to
  attend and participate in meetings of local legislative bodies. Other legal considerations
  related to meeting participation, attendance, and protocol will be addressed.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the LAS Advisory Committee receive and file this discussion item.

  B. PURPOSE OF LAS ADVISORY COMMITTEE

  Staff to provide an overview of the specific purpose of the LAS Advisory Committee, as
  well as how and why it was formed.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the LAS Advisory Committee receive and file this discussion item.

  C. DEVELOPMENT OF AN ACTION PLAN

  Staff to introduce an action plan to assist in the timely development of a Land
  Acknowledgement Statement. LAS Advisory Committee members to review and discuss
  the action plan.

  Staff recommends that the LAS Advisory Committee approve the action plan with or
  without amendments to fit the goals of the Committee.

  LAS Advisory Committee members to begin working on tasks included in the approved
  action plan.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the LAS Advisory Committee discuss and take action on items
  included in the approved action plan.

   City of San Gabriel
  MEMORANDUM
DATE:  September 14, 2021

TO:  Land Acknowledgement Statement Advisory Committee

FROM:  Matthew Morales-Stevens, Recreation Supervisor

SUBJECT:  LAS Advisory Committee Action Plan

SUMMARY
The San Gabriel City Council approved the development of the formation of a Land
Acknowledgement Statement (LAS) Advisory Committee to meet with the local tribal groups and
develop a proposed statement.

BACKGROUND
The HPCRC discussed the development of a land acknowledgement statement during their
November 4, 2020 commission meeting. Attachment A includes the research that Community
Development staff prepared for the discussion. This includes general information about how a
Land Acknowledgment statement is used, as well as sample acknowledgment statements.

In line with this, at the June 22, 2021 HEAR Commission meeting, at the request of Chair Chasity
Jennings-Nuñez, staff presented an item on the development of a land acknowledgment
statement for further discussion.

Since both Commissions have expressed interest in creating a statement and since the statement
would ultimately come before City Council for approval, staff presented this item to the Council.

At the August 17, 2021 Council Meeting City Council approved the creation of an advisory
committee to develop a Land Acknowledgement Statement for the City. This committee is now
known as the Land Acknowledgement Statement Advisory Committee and consists of two
members from City Council, 2 members from the HPCRC and 2 from the HEAR Commission.

PROPOSED ACTION PLAN
First Meeting
   Review the Outline for Creating a Land Acknowledgement Statement.
  o Attachment A includes the research provided by the staff to the HPCRC.
   Review the excerpt from the Draft Historic Context Statement Packet that was provided to
  the HPCRC at the August 25, 2021 Commission Meeting. Note, this draft statement is
  slated to be reviewed by the City Council at their meeting on October 5. (Attachment B).
   Draft sample questions in preparation for the meetings with the Tribal Leaders.
   LAS Action Plan
  September 14, 2021
  Page 2

    Determine a date and time that works best for the next two meetings.
  o These meetings will be primarily set aside to meet with the tribal leaders.

Meeting with Tribal Leaders
   Staff to schedule the individual meetings with each tribal leader.

Meeting(s) to develop the Land Acknowledgment (LAS)
   The LAS will be draft and then presented by staff to the HPCRC and HEAR Commission for
  approval.
   If the two commissions approve the LAS staff will then present the statement to City
  Council for final approval.

RECOMMENDATION

Per the information above, staff recommends that the LAS Advisory Committee approve the action
plan.

ATTACHMENTS
  A. Outline for Creating a Land Acknowledgment Statement
  B. Draft Historic Context Statement Packet Excerpt
